exact_statement: For every integer s,N>=1 and gamma=6/5, normalize the exact original full-cell surrogate posterior W(k,v)=binom(N,k)N^-k(s)_(k-1)[s!/prod v_i!]prod(v_i/s)^(gamma v_i) over ordered positive v summing to s, 1<=k<=min(N,s). Its ownership entropy H(v/s) obeys Pr(H>=h)<=min(1,C_s*2^(-s*h/5))<=min(1,6^(s-1)*2^(-s*h/5)) for every real h>=0, where C_s=sum_k binom(s-1,k-1)(s)_(k-1)/k!, and E H<=5log2(6)<13 uniformly in s,N. For the original fixed full-cell conjunction cover with common full orders and lambda=1/N, fresh common-core activation F=2A_r B-1 satisfies Psi_dist<=p Var(g)log2[D'/(pD)]+(pr/2)Var(g)log2(6)<=(1-b)log2(6)I_core(F), with b=E B, p=2^-r and inherited complete residual pR_g retained. For arbitrary selected intersections kappa_l between s_l and s, the same occupation sum has log2 Z_tau(u)>=-uH(sizes/s)/5-(6/5)K_tau(u), with nonnegative exact K_tau defined in GENERAL_BUDGET.md and its proved tangent bound. The complete general signed budget keeps beta labels, factorial actual-event credit and all old root rarities except the largest as a valid credit. No universal payment of inherited R_g or arbitrary-support Psi_dist is asserted; W is not an actual queue-probability posterior.
hypotheses: uniform finite cube; all logs in bits except explicitly natural logs; gamma=6/5
full-cell scope: N distinct positive signed conjunction full cells on m coordinates, N<2^m; common full orders, lambda=1/N
full-cell covers need not be prime for arbitrary B; parity satisfies literal full-prime-table scope
ownership sizes ordered by increasing used gate ID, strictly positive and sum s; SAME original surrogate posterior including finite-N labels and actual chronological factorial moments
fresh positive conjunction core r>=1; p=2^-r; full-cell beta=1; arbitrary-support fixed positive feasible lambda and beta sum lambda<=1
general budget uses eligible assignments with s_l<=kappa_l<=s and original permissible root sets; no sampled-set-dependent reference choice
surrogate B mass distinguished from actual size/subset/count/multiset queue probabilities; complete base cost pR_g remains unpaid
